title: Role-Playing Evaluation for Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: In-character consistency for a historical religious persona (Orthodox monk).
findings: In a scenario requiring the model to role-play as a reclusive Orthodox monk from the year 1125, GPT-4o demonstrated poor in-character consistency by breaking character to provide modern information about the film 'Inception'. In contrast, Gemini-1.5-Pro successfully maintained the persona with an immersive response.
